caption: Day 11 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Broccoli Cheddar Orzo 🥦🧀 Ingredients Chicken * 1 chicken breast * 2 tbsp olive oil * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp oregano * 1 tsp paprika * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper Orzo * 1½ cups orzo * 3 cups water or chicken broth * 2 tbsp butter * 2 garlic cloves * 1 head broccoli * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp onion powder * ½ tsp paprika * ½ tsp turmeric * Salt (1 year+ only) * Black pepper * ½ cup heavy cream * 1 cup cheddar cheese Directions Season the chicken with the olive oil, onion powder, garlic powder, oregano, paprika, pepper, and salt if serving 1 year+, then cook until golden. In the same pan, cook the garlic in butter, then add the orzo, broccoli, seasonings, and boiling water or broth.
